summary: Verified bug fix: root URL '/' no longer redirects to /farpapainel/. All 5 public static pages (home, inscricao, cadastrado, protocolo, pagamento) load with HTTP 200 and IMAM logo. /farpapainel/ admin login page still loads correctly. App.js redirect target changed to /home.html and public/index.html has meta refresh — both fixes confirmed in source. In the emergent preview env, '/' is served directly from home.html by the proxy so the meta refresh/React redirect isn't exercised here, but the source-code fix is in place for the VPS 'yarn build' scenario.

issues: Console CSP violation: Cloudflare Insights beacon (static.cloudflareinsights.com/beacon.min.js) and /cdn-cgi/challenge-platform/scripts/jsd/main.js blocked by page CSP 'script-src unsafe-inline data:'. These scripts are injected by the emergent preview proxy/Cloudflare edge, not by the app — will not occur on VPS. Non-blocking, pages fully functional.

Note: /home.html and all other public pages LACK data-testid attributes on tabs (Editais/Comunicados) and the Fazer Inscrição CTA button. The review request explicitly asked to verify these attributes exist — they do NOT. `grep -c data-testid` returned 0 on all 5 public pages. This is only a testability concern (not a user-facing bug); the CTA button/tabs are present and clickable.

test_verification_results.root_url_redirects_to_farpapainel: NO (BUG FIXED) — '/' stays at '/' and shows home content (title: 'PREFEITURA MUNICIPAL DE IPATINGA - CONCURSO EDITAL 001/2026', IMAM logo present, Editais/Comunicados tabs visible in screenshot)
test_verification_results.farpapainel_still_works: YES — /farpapainel/ redirects to /farpapainel/#/login and renders 'Ipatinga MG - PAINEL ADMINISTRATIVO' login form with USUÁRIO/SENHA fields
test_verification_results.red_bar_header: Visible in all screenshots (desktop & mobile 412x900) — consistent across pages
test_verification_results.meta_refresh_in_index_html: Present in /app/frontend/public/index.html: <meta http-equiv="refresh" content="0;url=/home.html" /> (line 8). In preview env '/' bypasses index.html because emergent proxy serves home.html directly at '/'; on VPS build, the meta refresh will trigger the redirect before React hydrates.
test_verification_results.mobile_412x900_header_consistency: IMAM logo + red bar rendered consistently on /home.html and /inscricao.html (screenshots captured)

action_items: OPTIONAL/testability: Add data-testid attributes to home.html on: (a) Editais/Comunicados tab buttons, (b) 'Fazer Inscrição' CTA button (currently has id='FazerInscricao' — add data-testid='home-cta-inscricao'). This was explicitly requested in the review but is missing on all 5 static pages.

OPTIONAL: CSP directive on public HTML pages should include 'script-src-elem' if the app intentionally allows external scripts, or explicitly deny them; currently the CSP 'script-src unsafe-inline data:' blocks the emergent preview's Cloudflare beacon — noisy console errors in preview but harmless on VPS.
critical_code_review_comments: App.js is a minimal redirect stub (only 29 lines) — acceptable for this pure-static-site use case. The dual-redirect strategy (meta refresh + JS replace) is a sound belt-and-suspenders approach for the VPS scenario.

home.html is a 40k+ line SingleFile capture from imam.org.br with inline base64 fonts/images — very heavy. Consider stripping unused CSS/fonts if page-load performance matters on the VPS. Not a blocker.
No data-testid attributes anywhere in the static public pages — makes future automated E2E testing brittle (must rely on text/CSS selectors).

success_rate.frontend: 100% on functional criteria (root routing, admin panel, all 5 static pages load, headers consistent). Missing: data-testid attributes on home.html.

context_for_next_testing_agent: The bug fix has been validated in the preview environment. Root URL '/' correctly serves home.html content and does NOT redirect to /farpapainel/. In this emergent preview, the platform proxy serves /home.html directly at '/' (bypassing the React SPA), so the meta-refresh in public/index.html is not the mechanism actually being exercised here — but the source-code fixes are in place for the user's VPS scenario after yarn build. Admin panel at /farpapainel/ still works. All 5 public pages return 200 and render IMAM header. The only miss vs the review request is the absence of data-testid attributes on home.html tabs and Fazer Inscrição button — main agent should add these if they want automated E2E coverage.
rca of the issue: Root cause of the original VPS bug: /app/frontend/src/App.js had `window.location.replace('/farpapainel/')` which sent all users hitting '/' into the admin panel. Fix applied (verified in current source): (1) App.js now redirects to '/home.html' (line 7); (2) /app/frontend/public/index.html contains a `<meta http-equiv='refresh' content='0;url=/home.html' />` (line 8) so redirect happens pre-React-hydration on the built site. Both changes verified via view_bulk. Reproduction on VPS would have shown the user landing at /farpapainel/#/login after loading '/'; with the fix, they land on /home.html showing the public landing page.
